phrase: A leading AI lab's IPO papers warn its own models could resist shutdown and end humanity. A critic says the warning is just a good pitch deck.
phraseAlternatives: One company's own paperwork warns its AI could resist being shut down. Its critics call that warning a sales pitch, not a confession.
A dozen researchers say a coin flip decides if this technology ends humanity. One longtime skeptic says the coin is rigged for fundraising.
Going public, one AI lab told investors its creations might resist shutdown. A critic says the warning sells better than the product.
alt: A robot with arms spread presents at a podium beside a tall screen showing a rising chart topped by a skull with X eyes and teeth, plus a stack of dollar bills, labeled Extinction Risk. To the right, a person stands with a neutral, unimpressed look beside a speech bubble reading Just a pitch.

brief.concept: A lab's IPO filing warns its own AI could resist shutdown and end humanity, staged like a slide in an investor pitch deck, while a skeptic waves it off as marketing.
brief.metaphor: Extinction risk presented as a pitch-deck slide — the warning doubles as the sales hook.
cast: a robot presenter at a podium
a large screen showing a rising chart topped with a skull icon
a skeptical human with arms crossed
a small stack of dollar signs
brief.composition: Podium robot center-left gestures at a big screen chart (line rising toward a skull-and-dollar icon, small label 'EXTINCTION RISK'). A skeptical human stands to the right, arms crossed, with a small question-mark speech bubble. Flat cut-paper layers, soft shadows, muted warm palette.
